content: N deemɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ rɑɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ Misipɑɔ bɑ nɛɛ, bɑǹ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ ɡoo ben bii wɔndiɑ ɡoo wɛ̃ɛmɔ u suɑ kurɔ.
Mɑ bɑ nɑ bɑ sinɑ Betɛliɔ Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ sere n kɑ kuɑ yokɑ. Bɑ wuri kuɑ kɑ dɑm
bɑ nɛɛ, Gusunɔ, bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn Yinni, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ bɛsɛn bwese kɛrɑ tiɑ yɑ kpeerɑ.
Mɑ bɑ seewɑ buru buru yellu bɑ yɑ̃ku yeru kuɑ mi, mɑ bɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu kɑ siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kunu kuɑ ten wɔllɔ.
Yen biruwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɡeemɑ sɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ kɑ bɔ̃ri sɑ nɛɛ, be bɑ kun de Misipɑɔ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ sɑ ko bu ɡowɑ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, berɑ̀ bɛsɛ Isirelibɑ sɔɔ, bɑǹ kɑ sun mɛnnɛ mi.
N deemɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wee sɑ bɛsɛn bwese kɛri tiɑ ɡo.
Tɛ̃ ɑmɔnɑ sɑ ko ko su kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ be bɑ tie kurɔbu wɑɑwɑ. Domi sɑ bɔ̃ruɑ kɔ Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ sɑ nɛɛ, sɑǹ mɑɑ bu bɛsɛn bii wɔndiɑbɑ wɛ̃ɛmɔ bu suɑ kurɔbu.
Mɑ bɑ bikiɑnɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɛsɛ sɔɔ berɑ̀ bɑǹ nɛ Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ Misipɑɔ. Mɑ bɑ deemɑ ɡoo kun nɛ sɑɑ Yɑbɛsin di ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Gɑlɑdiɔ.
Domi sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ tɔmbu ɡɑrɑ bɑ deemɑ Yɑbɛsiɡii ɡoo kun wɑ̃ɑ mi.
Sɑɑ yerɑ Isireli be sɔɔ, bɑ tɑbu kowobu nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (12.000) ɡɔsɑ bɑ bu woodɑ wɛ̃ bɑ nɛɛ, i doo i Yɑbɛsiɡibu ɡo kpuro.
I tɔn durɔbu kpuro ɡoowo kɑ kurɔ be bɑ durɔ yɛ̃ kɔ.
Ye bɑ turɑ mi, bɑ wɔndiɑbɑ wɑ tɔnu nɛɛru (400) be bɑ kun durɔ yɛ̃. Mɑ bɑ bu mwɛɛrimɑ bɑ kɑ nɑ ben sɑnsɑniɔ Siloɔ Kɑnɑnin temɔ.
Yen biruwɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ be bɑ dɑ bɑ kukuɑ Rimɔɔn kpee wɔruɔ ɡɔriɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bu yɑrimɑ, tɑbu kpɑ, bɑ dorɑ.
Yerɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ be, bɑ yɑrimɑ. Mɑ bɑ bu wɔndiɑ be wɛ̃ bɑ suɑ kurɔbu, be bɑ mwɛɛrimɑ sɑɑ Yɑbɛsin di mi, Gɑlɑdin temɔ. Adɑmɑ kurɔ be, bɑǹ bu dɑbiru turɑ.
Mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ ben wɔnwɔndu wɑ yèn sɔ̃ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ ben bwese kɛrɑ kɑndɑ.
Mɑ Isirelibɑn ɡuro ɡurobu bɑ nɛɛ, wee tɔn kurɔbu sɑri Bɛnyɑmɛɛn bweseru sɔɔ. Mɑnɑ ben tɔn durɔ be bɑ tie bɑ koo kurɔbu wɑ.
Domi n ǹ weenɛ ben bweseru tu kɑm ko, kpɑ bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri tiɑ ye, yu ɡbi.
Adɑmɑ sɑǹ kpɛ̃ su bu bɛsɛn bii wɔndiɑbɑ wɛ̃ bu suɑ kurɔbu, domi sɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ kɑ bɔ̃ri sɑ nɛɛ, Isireli wi u win bii wɔndiɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ ɡoo wɛ̃ u suɑ kurɔ, yen yɛ̃ro u kɑm ko.

Adɑmɑ bɑ bwisikɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wee wɔ̃ɔ kɑ wɔ̃ɔn tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑrɑ turuku kuɑ te sɑ rɑ Yinni Gusunɔ kue Siloɔ. Silo ye, yɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ swɑɑɔ ye yɑ dɔɔ sɑɑ Betɛlin di sere Sikɛmuɔ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerɔ, Betɛli kɑ Lebonɑn bɑɑ sɔɔ.
Mɑ bɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ bwisi yini kɑ̃ bɑ nɛɛ, i doo i kuke resɛm ɡbɑɑnɔ.
Kpɑ i n yɔɔru bwɛ̃ɛ i n Silon wɔndiɑbɑ mɑrɑ, be bɑ koo yɑrimɑ bɑ n yɑɑmɔ. Ì n bu wɑ mɛ, kpɑ i yɑrimɑ ɡbɑɑ nin min di, i bu sɛ̃re i mwɛɛri i kɑ doonɑ bɛɛn temɔ bu ko bɛɛn kurɔbu.
Ben mɔwɔbu bɑ̀ n nɑ, bɑ sun weeweenu koosi, sɑ ko bu wisi su nɛɛ, sɑǹ kpĩɑ sɑ bɛɛ kpuro kurɔbu wɑɑwe Yɑbɛsin tɑɑ bi sɔɔ. Nɡe mɛ n ǹ ben tii bɑ bɛɛ bii wɔndiɑ be wɛ̃, bɑǹ ben nɔɔ mwɛɛru kɔbie.
Mɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ be, bɑ kɑ tɔn ben ɡɑri sɔmburu kuɑ. Bɑ wɔndiɑ be mwɛɛrɑ sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ yɑɑmɔ Siloɔ. Ben bɑɑwure u wɔndiɑ wɑ u sɛ̃re u suɑ kurɔ. Mɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ ben temɔ. Bɑ wure bɑ ben wusu bɑnɑ, bɑ sinɑ mi.
Yen biruwɑ Isireli be bɑ tie bɑ yɑrinɑ. Bɑɑwure u dɑ u win bwese kɛrɑ deemɑ win temɔ.
N deemɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Isirelibɑ bɑǹ kpɑro mɔ. Ben bɑɑwure u mɔ̀wɑ nɡe mɛ u kĩ.
